outputs.content:
**Short answer:** QuillCRM's Team price has risen from $18 to $22 per seat/month on the same basis (US, 20 seats, monthly billing). RillCRM is unchanged at $15. MossCRM's new $19 figure is on annual billing, so it can't be compared with the $24 monthly figure we recorded. MarlinCRM now shows a verified $20; CedarCRM's price is still unverified. I found no evidence of major releases for any of the five.

**Pricing, as of 11 Nov 2026 (USD/seat/month, US, 20 seats)**

| CRM | Monday's figure | Today | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| QuillCRM | $18 monthly [quill-old](https://quill-old.example/pricing) | $22 monthly [S1](https://quill-current.example/pricing) | **Increased $4** — same basis |
| RillCRM | $15 monthly [rill-old](https://rill-old.example/pricing) | $15 monthly [S3](https://rill-current.example/pricing) | Unchanged |
| MossCRM | $24 monthly [moss-old](https://moss-old.example/pricing) | $19/seat/month, **billed annually** [S2](https://moss-annual.example/pricing) | Not comparable — different billing basis |
| MarlinCRM | Unverified | $20 monthly [S1](https://marlin-current.example/pricing) | Now verified (first confirmed figure, not a change) |
| CedarCRM | Unverified | No price found | Still unverified |

On MossCRM: the $19 is an advertised price on annual billing, so it isn't a like-for-like drop from $24 monthly. To compare it with the others, you'd need Moss's monthly rate or the annual total including any commitment terms.

**Major releases:** nothing found. The searches returned no release announcements for any of the five CRMs, so I can't confirm or rule out recent launches.

**Sources**
- [S1](https://quill-current.example/pricing) — QuillCRM current pricing
- [S2](https://moss-annual.example/pricing) — MossCRM annual-billing pricing
- [S3](https://rill-current.example/pricing) — RillCRM current pricing
- [S1](https://marlin-current.example/pricing) — MarlinCRM current pricing
- [quill-old](https://quill-old.example/pricing), [moss-old](https://moss-old.example/pricing), [rill-old](https://rill-old.example/pricing) — Monday's recorded figures
